name: UltimaKit – Admin Tools and Site Utilities – Lightweight Plugin Replacer
author: Ankit Panchal

sections.description:
Is your WordPress dashboard cluttered with too many single-purpose plugins?

UltimaKit is the lightweight “Plugin Replacer.” We combined the most essential WordPress utilities into one modular, performance-optimized plugin. You can enable only what you need and keep your site fast.

🔌 Plugins You Can Uninstall

By installing UltimaKit, you can safely deactivate and delete these common plugins to speed up your site:

Yoast Duplicate Post → Use UltimaKit’s Duplicate Pages & Posts.

SVG Support / Safe SVG → Use UltimaKit’s SVG Upload.

Disable Gutenberg → Use UltimaKit’s Disable Gutenberg Manager.

WPS Hide Login → Use UltimaKit’s Change Login URL.

Limit Login Attempts → Use UltimaKit’s Login Security.

Redirection → Use UltimaKit’s 301 Redirect Manager.

Cookie Notice → Use UltimaKit’s GDPR Compliance Tool.

Simple Custom CSS/JS → Use UltimaKit’s Code Manager.

Maintenance Mode → Use UltimaKit’s Maintenance Mode.

Post Types Order → Use UltimaKit’s Drag & Drop Sort Order.

🚀 Top Free Features (The “Gateway” Collection)

These are the most popular tools included in the free version:

Duplicate Posts & Pages: Clone any content with a single click.

SVG Upload Support: Safely upload SVG logos and icons to the Media Library.

Disable Gutenberg: Completely disable the Block Editor for specific post types or the whole site.

Hide Admin Notices: Clear the clutter by moving annoying marketing banners to a separate panel.

Drag & Drop Order: Reorder Posts, Pages, and Custom Post Types easily.

Login Customizer: Change the default WordPress login URL and replace the WP logo.

🛠️ Complete Feature List

Content & Management (Free)

Duplicate Pages & Posts: Clone content instantly.

Drag & Drop Order: Custom sorting for posts and pages.

SVG Upload: Enable safe SVG uploads.

Auto-Generate Slugs: Auto-create SEO-friendly slugs.

Featured Image Column: See images directly in the admin list view.

ID Column: Display Post/Page IDs in the admin table.

Clean Up Admin Bar: Remove “Howdy Admin,” WP Logo, and other clutter.

Open External Links in New Tab: Automatically add target=”_blank”.

Security & Hardening (Free)

Change Login URL: Hide your /wp-admin from bots.

Limit Login Attempts: Block brute-force attacks.

Disable XML-RPC: Prevent common DDoS attack vectors.

Hide WordPress Version: Obfuscate version number to prevent targeted exploits.

Block “Admin” Username: Prevent creation of insecure usernames.

Disable File Editing: Stop hackers from editing theme files via dashboard.

Auto-Logout Inactive Users: Session security for idle admins.

Disallow Bad Requests: Block malicious strings and base64 injections.

Optimization & “De-Bloat” (Free)

Disable Gutenberg: Revert to Classic Editor where needed.

Disable Emojis & Embeds: Remove extra JS files to speed up frontend.

Disable Comments: Turn off comments globally or on specific types.

Disable RSS Feeds: Stop scrapers from stealing content.

Disable Cart Fragments (Woo): Fix the #1 WooCommerce speed issue.

Heartbeat Control: Reduce server resource usage.

Remove Query Strings: Improve GTMetrix/PageSpeed scores.

Custom Code & Design (Free)

Header/Footer Code: Add Google Analytics or Facebook Pixel scripts.

Custom CSS/JS: Add style tweaks without editing style.css.

Custom Admin Footer: White-label your dashboard for clients.

Login Page Styler: Hide login errors and shake animations.

⚡ Pro Features (Agency Power)

Unlock the full “Site Manager” suite for Agencies and Developers:

SEO Title & Meta Editor: A lightweight alternative to heavy SEO plugins.

Custom Post Types (CPT) UI: Create CPTs and Taxonomies without code.

Admin Activity Logger: Track who changed what on your site.

Maintenance Mode: Creating “Coming Soon” pages.

White Labeling: Rename “UltimaKit” to your own brand name.

Advanced WooCommerce Tools: Disable breadcrumbs, custom “Add to Cart” text, and more.

Export/Import: Move your settings to other client sites instantly.

View All Pro Features & Pricing

🔥 What’s Next?

We are actively building features based on your feedback.
Need a specific tool? Submit a request here.

sections.installation:
Install using the WordPress built-in Plugin installer, or extract the zip file and drop the contents in the wp-content/plugins/ directory.

Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu.

Go to UltimaKit in the admin sidebar.

Enable only the modules you need to keep your site lightweight.
sections.faq:
Why should I use UltimaKit instead of installing separate plugins?

Every plugin you install adds database overhead and potential security risks. UltimaKit allows you to replace 20+ single-purpose plugins (like Duplicate Post, SVG Support, Disable Gutenberg) with one clean, optimized codebase.

Does enabling many modules slow down my site?

No. UltimaKit uses a modular architecture. If you do not enable a module, its code does not run. It is significantly faster than running 20 separate plugins.

Can I use this for client sites?

Yes! The “White Label” and “Clean Admin” features make it perfect for agencies who want to hand over a clean, professional dashboard to clients.

Is it compatible with WooCommerce?

Yes. We have dedicated WooCommerce optimization modules (Free & Pro) to speed up your store, such as disabling cart fragments and hiding out-of-stock products.
